contexts.text: Jehovah shall remove from thee... all the evil languors of Egypt ().
A languid heart () = the will of good no longer.
The land = the Church, which is said to mourn and languish () when falsities begin to be... acknowledged as truths.
The evil languors of Egypt = the falsities originating from the evils in the natural man.
To mourn and languish () = the deprivation of (the truth of the Church).
She that hath borne seven languisheth () = that the Church... would perish. AE 721:7.
That neither shall there be any Knowledges of truth which are of the Church, is signified by, all the trees of the field shall languish upon him ().
To be sad, and to languish () = to labour.
The devastation and desolation of the Knowledges of good and truth from the natural sense of the Word, are signified by to mourn, languish, etc. ().
The desolation of the Church is described by to mourn, to be confounded, and to languish ().
